#  12464 - Modeling and Simulation of Discrete Systems Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12464 - module is no longer offered from WS 2023/24**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Modeling and Simulation of Discrete Systems**  |  
|  Modellierung und Simulation diskreter Systeme   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. phil. habil. Wagner, Gerd 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students will learn the basic theory and techniques of computer simulation and simulation modeling of discrete dynamic systems, including practical methods and tools for modeling and simulation. The course contents will be project- driven. Students will apply the knowledge learned on a number of collaborative modeling and simulation projects, thus acquiring the desired skills.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Event-Based Simulation
  * Event Graphs
  * Object Event Simulation
  * Modeling Activities and Processing Networks
  * Using the Simulation Tools OESjs and AnyLogic

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | A course in programming at least equivalent to the module 
  * 12105: Einführung in die Programmierung 

Knowledge of statistics and/or probability theory is useful.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Research paper/essay / 60 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 60 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Discrete Event Simulation Engineering, Gerd Wagner, 2022, E-Book: https://sim4edu.com/reading/des-engineering/

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Successful completion of four project assignments (50%),
  * Four online quizzes/tests, each 15 minutes (each 12,5 %)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Informatik M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Praktische Informatik“ (level 400)
  * Study programme eBusiness M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in main focus „Anwendung und Betrieb von eBusiness-Systeme“
  * Study programme Artificial Intelligence M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Advanded Methods“
  * Study programme Cyber Security M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Computer Science“
  * Study programme Physics M. Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Minor Subject“

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture Modeling and Simulation of Discrete Systems
  * Exercise Modeling and Simulation of Discrete Systems
  * Examination Modeling and Simulation of Discrete Systems

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 19.04.2023 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
